label: E. coli
note: Generated by visualizer/tools/gather_machines.py from data/catalogue/gather.json, the saved answers of UniProt, the Gene Ontology and the Protein Data Bank, and the species' own proteins: do not edit. The contract is schema/MACHINE_DOSSIERS.md.

rules.proteins: A protein is named with a machine where its reviewed UniProt entry carries the machine's Gene Ontology term or a narrower one. 'part': named with it (and carrying one of its keywords, where gather.json gives them) and held by the chosen entry as an entity of the species, or a protein of the species in the machine's seed entry. 'part by keyword': named with it and carrying the keyword, not held by the entry. 'named': named with it by the term alone. A protein of the species that the entry holds and the ontology does not name with the machine is counted under the structure ('in_entry_only') and left out of the measure. No protein is matched by a name.
rules.structure: Candidates are the experimental entries of the Protein Data Bank in which a polymer entity from an organism under taxon 562 (Escherichia coli) is, by RCSB's mapping, one of the machine's proteins; every hit is read. They are ranked by the proteins present; then an entry in which those proteins' residues with coordinates add up to at least 70 per cent of them before one with less; then an entry at 4.5 Å or better before a coarser one (an entry with no resolution, of nuclear magnetic resonance, counts as coarser); then the fewest other polymer entities (partners, nucleic acids, other organisms' proteins); then the proteins nearly whole (at least 80 per cent of the protein's own length with coordinates in every copy); then the proteins' lengths with coordinates added up in whole proteins; then resolution; then the most copies of them in the first biological assembly; then id. gather.json may name another entry, and says why.
rules.measure: The call is in the terms of tools/measure_particle.py --machine: what is not the machine is left out by entity id (nucleic acids that are not its parts, other organisms' proteins, proteins of the species not named with it); each part is NAME=ENTITY,ENTITY. A size measured so is the viewer's own; the Protein Data Bank states none.
rules.join: Each protein is joined to the Protein atlas by the atlas's own id (RCSB's mapping of an entity to UniProt; the entry file's own reference is kept beside it). by_protein gives, for each protein of the atlas, the machines it is a part of, with the tier.
rules.measurable: measurable speaks of the proteins the entry holds: their residues with coordinates add up to at least 70 per cent of them. How much of the machine the entry holds is said beside it (whole.present of whole.proteins_wanted).
